name: Evasive Jet
text: Frequency once per day Trigger A creature that you can see targets you with an attack. Requirements You aren't encumbered. With a reflexive burst from your siphons, you try to flit away from the attack. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the attack fails or critically fails, you can also Stride or Swim up to 10 feet as part of the reaction. Special If you have the Spray Ink feat, you can also expel a puff of ink as part of this reaction. In addition to the circumstance bonus to AC, you're Concealed against the triggering attack.

name: Evasive Roll
text: As a reaction when you are targeted by an area effect, you can immediately Step to an adjacent square. If this would move you outside the area, you take no damage.

name: Even More Smashing!
text: Your attacks have become so powerful that they can shatter armor and shields. When you Strike a creature that has hardness (such as a construct with construct armor) or an enemy using an action such as , you deal additional damage to that creature or shield equal to your level or the target's hardness (whichever is lower).

name: Ever Vigilant
text: Your extra set of eyes allows you to constantly be aware of your surroundings. You aren't Off-Guard to flanking creatures of your level or lower.

name: Exact Retribution
text: Trigger You . You riposte as you're almost brought low. Make a single Strike against the triggering creature. If this Strike brings a foe to 0 Hit Points, the triggering activation of Swear Vengeance doesn't count against its frequency, and your condition decreases by 1.

name: Exaggerate Strength
text:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You are about to attempt a saving throw against an incapacitation effect.

You inflate your own ego and build yourself up into a tall tale version of yourself more capable than you actually are. While this doesn't make you any more powerful, the effect is just enough to bedevil incapacitating magic. The triggering incapacitation effect treats you as if you were two levels higher.

name: Exaggerated Tales
text: Goblin stories are legendary. When you spend 1 minute telling a story, you can attempt a check against up to 5 creatures' Will DCs to enrapture them. On a success, the creature listens incredulously, becoming for the duration.

name: Excavating Tentacles
text: Your reinforced tentacles wrap together to burrow through the ground. You gain a burrow Speed of 15 feet for as long as your tentacles are wrapped together, and then you Burrow. You take a -10-foot status penalty to your land and fly Speeds until you unwrap your tentacles as a free action.

name: Exceptional Artisan
text: You take great pride in the mastery of your craft. Gain a skill feat in for a skill that you're at least a master in. You also gain in that skill.

name: Exceptional Reach
text: You can leverage your size and strength alongside lengthy and heavy weapons to strike foes who would normally be safe from you. While in this stance, when you wield a melee weapon that requires two hands and doesn't have reach, you can change between a typical two-handed grip and an extended two-handed grip using an Interact action. Weapons wielded in your extended two-handed grip have a reach of 10 feet.

name: Exclusively Quadrupedal
text: You use your middle arms as feet so much that you've lost the ability to use them as arms. You lose the Change Posture action, and you can no longer be in bipedal posture. Your land Speed increases to 40 feet. You gain the Solid Stance feat. If you already had the Solid Stance feat, you can retrain that feat to another ancestry feat when you select this feat.

name: Executive Aide
text: You've been granted your own administrative assistant who uses drones to deliver you useful items for a nominal fee. You can use even if you've already used it after purchasing goods, and you can use it as a single action instead of a 2-action activity, during which a corporate drone appears to deliver the item directly into your hand. In addition, five times per day, you can use Prescient Planner to pull out a common consumable item of up to 6 levels lower than your level.

name: Exodus of Dreams
text: You can join dreamscapes far more often than other dream dragons, and you can even use them to transport yourself a great distance. You can use your innate Dream Message spell from Join Dreamscape at will, instead of once per day. Once per day, when you use your innate dream message spell from Join Dreamscape, if the creature receiving the message is asleep when you send the message and allows you to do so, you can teleport to that creature's location just after delivering your message. This otherwise has the effects of a 6th-level Teleport that only brings you through the dream and fails if it would bring along any other creatures.

name: Exoskeletal Guard
text: Your battle-hardened carapace provides enhanced protection. You gain a +1 item bonus to AC from your natural armor and resistance 2 to piercing damage.

name: Expand Mental Network
text: You can connect with other minds, even if they aren't your host's. You can cast Mindlink as a 1st-rank occult innate spell twice per day.

name: Expanded Connection
text: Increase the number of spells in your repertoire and number of spell slots you gain from mystic archetype feats by 1 for each spell rank other than your two highest mystic spell slots.

name: Expanded Resistance
text: The lux aeterna ritual makes you more flexible and less focused than a traditionalist dragon, and so you've found a way to become resistant to just about every kind of energy, not just the kind dragons of your heritage usually can resist. You gain resistance 5 to acid, cold, electricity, fire, force, mental, negative, poison, positive, and sonic damage.

name: Expanded Senses
text: You know that when it comes to surviving a dangerous situation, every moment counts. To that end, you've trained long and hard to improve your natural senses, pushing them to the limits of their ability. Select an imprecise sense you have, such as hearing or scent. The range of the selected imprecise sense increases to 120 feet. Special : You can select this feat more than once. Each time you do, select a different imprecise sense you possess.

name: Expanded Solar Reserves
text: Your starburst markings can store much greater reserves of solar energy, enabling you to heal yourself more frequently. The frequency of Siphon Solar Vitality increases to once per hour, rather than once per day.

name: Expansive Array
text: Select two additional turret arrays (each 2d8 damage, range increment 60 feet, tech): mental, poison, vitality, or void. Special: you can take this feat a second time for two different arrays.

name: Expansive Verse
text: Your songs become more complex and tinged with greater magic. Each day during your daily preparations, you can choose one common 2nd-rank spell from the occult spell list. You can cast this spell as an occult innate spell once before your next daily preparations.

name: Expedition Assistant
text: You studied the methodologies of one of Jhavom's fine expeditionary academies and know a few magical standbys for dangerous missions. You can cast Akashic Download and Shifting Surge as 1st-rank divine innate spells once per day each.

name: Expeditious Search
text: You have a system that lets you search at great speed, finding details and secrets twice as quickly as others can. When Searching, you take half as long as usual to Search a given area. This means that while exploring, you double the Speed you can move while ensuring you've Searched an area before walking into it (up to half your Speed). If you're legendary in Perception, you instead Search areas four times as quickly.

name: Expense Account
text: Your boss provides you with useful gifts emblazoned with the company's logo, even though the delivery seems to cost as much as the actual item. You gain the and general feats. When using Prescient Planner, you can find and draw the item from a worn container as a 2-action activity rather than taking 1 minute. You pick up new gifts the next time you're able to purchase goods.

name: Experienced Laborer
text: Your hold has worked as laborers for generations, and as a result you've become an expert not only at the work that you do, but commanding respect and fair treatment from your employers. You become trained in a Lore skill of your choosing. In addition, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks to when consulting other professionals related to the chosen Lore skill.

name: Experienced Professional
text: Your professional experience lets you earn a living reliably. When you Subsist using a relevant Lore skill, you always earn enough to keep yourself comfortable, even on a failure.

name: Experienced Smuggler
text: You're skilled at concealing contraband. When you hide a small object on your person, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Stealth to keep it hidden, and searchers take a penalty to find it.

name: Experienced Tracker
text: You've developed extraordinary tracking abilities. You can Track at full Speed without penalty, and you can Track creatures in urban environments as easily as in the wilderness.

name: Expert Guidance
text: You lead others by teaching and imparting insights onto them. Whenever an ally selects you as the target of their attempt to Follow the Expert, you increase the circumstance bonus they receive to their skill check by an additional +1, or an additional +2 if you have master proficiency rank or higher (for a total of +3 for expert, +5 for master, and +6 for legendary).

name: Expert Mystic Spellcasting
text: You gain the Expert Spellcasting benefits.

name: Expert Set-Up
text: Trigger You roll initiative. Whether by patient analysis or a moment of inspiration, you're prepared for combat. You can Interact to draw a weapon, or you can Step.

name: Expert Witchwarper Spellcasting
text: You gain the Expert Spellcasting benefits.

name: Explosive Deflection
text: Trigger You're in the area of a grenade explosion. Requirements You're aware of the attack, wielding a gun, and not Off-Guard. You attempt to detonate the grenade with a well-timed shot from your gun. Expend an amount of ammunition from your gun equal to its usage, as if you'd fired the gun. You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to your Reflex save against the triggering grenade. Determine if you succeed on your save before rolling for anyone else in the area. If you succeed on your Reflex save, you cause the grenade to explode prematurely. Select a space of your choice directly between you and the attacker. The deflected grenade explodes in the selected space, and you don't need to save again if you're in the new explosion area.

You attempt to detonate the grenade with a well-timed shot from your gun. Expend an amount of ammunition from your gun equal to its usage, as if you'd fired the gun. The deflected grenade explodes in the selected space, and you don't need to save again if you're in the new explosion area.

name: Explosive Engineering
text: Frequency once per day You can craft technology quickly at the expense of safety. Once per day, you can an Item you know the formula for with the consumable and tech traits. You can reduce the time it would take to finish Crafting the item to 10 minutes instead of 4 days, and you reduce the materials needed for each 10 minutes of Crafting taken as you seek out more scrap (so by about half). On a critical failure, you cause an explosion and take ] damage per item level, destroying the raw materials.

name: Explosive Shot
text: You gain the Explosive Shot mod. Explosive Shot (non-area weapon): the modded item deals 1 splash damage per weapon damage die, of the same type the item deals.

name: Explosive Surprise
text: You've mastered the infamous ysoki martial art of spitting a live grenade from your mouth. It takes 10 minutes to safely prepare a grenade and store it in your cheek pouch. As a single action, you can draw and throw this specially prepared grenade using your mouth. You don't need a free hand to do so.

name: Express Driver
text: You can push vehicles to their limits. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Piloting checks when driving at full speed, and vehicles you pilot have their speed increased by 10 feet.

name: Extend Directive
text: Trigger Your turn begins, and you issued a 2-action directive on your last turn. With exceptional flair, you can repeat your orders with a single word or gesture. You immediately issue the 1-action version of the directive that you issued on your previous turn.

name: Extend Directive
text:
Trigger Your turn begins, and you issued a 2-action directive on your last turn.

With exceptional flair, you can repeat your orders with a single word or gesture. You immediately issue the 1-action version of the directive that you issued on your previous turn.

name: Extended Family
text: You always have an inkling where you can find extended family. You become trained in Diplomacy. If you would automatically become trained in Diplomacy (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. When you attempt to [[/act make-an-impression]] or to make a Request from another ysoki, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your checks.

name: Extended Vitality
text: You can feel and reach out to your bonded allies regardless of range. You can Transfer Vitality to any bonded ally as long as they're on the same planet as you.

name: Extended Vitality
text: You can feel and reach out to your bonded allies regardless of range. You can to any bonded ally as long as they're on the same planet as you.

name: Extra Hands
text: Your gravitational field has strengthened, and your ability to manipulate objects within it has improved. Your gravitational field grants you two additional hands, following the rules for characters with more than two hands. The Switch Hands action gains the novian trait when you switch to or from any of your gravity hands. Special A novian with Extra Hands can select the All Hands on Deck and Double Draw standardized ancestry feats.

name: Extreme Accuracy
text: When you Aim, the benefits apply if your mark is within range up to your weapon's fourth range increment. Additionally, you ignore the penalty for attacking your mark at up to four range increments away.

name: Extreme Accuracy
text: When you , the benefits apply if your mark is within range up to your weapon's fourth range increment. Additionally, you ignore the penalty for attacking your mark at up to four range increments away.

name: Extreme Copaxi Superstition
text: You're so accustomed to being wary around magic that you've undergone physiological changes that make your body resistant to it. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against spells and magical effects. Increase the bonus you gain from Copaxi Superstition to a +2 circumstance bonus (or a +3 circumstance bonus if the effect changes gravity or can cause you to fall Prone).

name: Eye for Numbers
text: You quickly assess quantities and values. You can determine the exact number of items in a group or the value of a collection at a glance, and gain a +1 to checks involving finance.

name: Eyes Open
text: You're of the school of thought that an alert halfling is a halfling who stays alive, and you keep your head on a swivel out of habit. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks made as initiative rolls.

name: Eyeswide Detective Dedication

meta.Prerequisites: ["Wis +2 or ability to cast occult spells", "trained in Society"]

text: Access: member of the Eyeswide Agency The agency has provided you with some psychic training that helps you question suspects and track down leads. You gain limited telepathy with a range of 30 feet. If you already have limited telepathy, increase its range by 30 feet. You also become an expert in Society and gain the Streetwise skill feat. If you already have the Streetwise skill feat, whenever you use Society to Gather Information and get a critical failure, you get a failure instead.

name: Face in the Crowd
text: You can blend into busy areas effortlessly. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks to Hide or Sneak in crowds of five or more people.

name: Fading Presence
text: Sometimes, people forget about you, and it's happening more and more lately. Increase the DC of attempts to Gather Information on you by 1 for each Gap-touched feat you have. Additionally, you gain a +1 status bonus to Stealth checks to .

name: Faerie Ring Transport
text: While faeries are rumored to transport themselves via rings of mushrooms, also known as faerie rings or faerie circles, you have found a way to actually transport yourself between them. You can cast Tree Stride as an innate primal spell once per day, except that instead of transporting between two trees, you transport between two faerie rings.

name: Fan the Hammer
text: Frequency once per round Requirements Your last action this turn was an Area Fire or Auto-Fire. You hold down the trigger and continue blasting. You Area Fire or Auto-Fire, ignoring your weapon's unwieldy trait. You don't designate a primary target with this attack, and creatures you damage with this attack don't gain the Suppressed condition.

You hold down the trigger and continue blasting. You Area Fire or Auto-Fire, ignoring your weapon's unwieldy trait. You don't designate a primary target with this attack, and creatures you damage with this attack don't gain the condition.

name: Fantastic Ferocity
text: Trigger You use Shobhad Ferocity. You continue to battle even as you acquire mortal injuries. Make a single Strike. If this Strike brings a foe to 0 Hit Points, this activation of Shobhad Ferocity doesn't count against its frequency.

name: Far Traveler
text: You can travel especially far overland, even through adverse conditions. When traveling long distances overland, you reduce the movement penalty to your travel speed from difficult terrain or greater difficult terrain by half, though this has no effect on your movement during an encounter. For example, if you had a Speed of 30 feet, you normally travel 24 miles a day in normal terrain, 12 miles a day in difficult terrain, and 8 miles a day in greater difficult terrain, but with Far Traveler, you would travel 18 miles a day in difficult terrain and 16 miles a day in greater difficult terrain.

name: Far-Reaching Mind
text: Through rigorous mental exercises or natural talent, your psychic senses extend farther than average. Increase the ranges of your limited telepathy and thoughtsense by 10 feet each.

name: Fascinating Performance
text: Your performances captivate audiences. You can attempt a Performance check to make one observing creature fascinated by you until the end of your next turn.

name: Fast Recovery
text: Your body quickly bounces back from afflictions. You regain twice as many Hit Points from resting. Each time you succeed at a Fortitude save against an ongoing disease or poison, you reduce its stage by 2, or by 1 against a virulent disease or poison. Each critical success you achieve against an ongoing disease or poison reduces its stage by 3, or by 2 against a virulent disease or poison. In addition, you reduce the severity of your drained condition by 2 when you rest for a night instead of by 1.

name: Fast Synergy
text: People follow your lead because you help push them to their ultimate potential. Each of your allies gain a second reaction if they start their turn within 100 feet of you and can perceive you. This second reaction can only be used for directives you issue.

name: Fast Synergy
text: People follow your lead because you help push them to their ultimate potential. Each of your allies gain a second reaction if they start their turn within 100 feet of you and can perceive you. This second reaction can only be used for directives you issue.

name: Fastest Route
text: By recalculating variables like traffic, weather, and attacks from giant space tardigrades, you can determine the best way to get from here to there, and you might even wildly claim to be able to get there in a shorter distance than it actually is. When you succeed at a Piloting check to [[/act navigate]], you critically succeed instead. If you critically fail a Piloting check to [[/act plot-course]], you fail instead.

name: Fatal Error
text:
Frequency once per day
You can wield the Gap to muddle a creature's existence, potentially deleting them as thoroughly as if you killed them. Choose one creature within 30 feet. The target must attempt a save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.
Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is Slowed 1 for 1 round.

Failure The target is slowed 1 for 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, and the target must attempt a save against the same DC. If it fails, it dies. All records and memories of the creature become hazy, similar to those of the Gap. This critical failure effect has the death trait.

name: Favored Disguise
text: You have one disguise you've perfected beyond all others. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to maintain your chosen disguise and can don it in half the usual time.

name: Fearless
text: Whether it comes from a sense of duty or a desire to succeed, you rarely flinch when confronted by fearsome foes. If you roll a success on a saving throw against a fear effect, you get a critical success instead.

name: Fearsome
text: You're as fearsome as a dragon. You gain the trained proficiency rank in Intimidation. If you would automatically become trained in Intimidation (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the Intimidating Glare skill feat.

name: Fearsome Gaze
text: Your towering presence unnerves most beings. You can Demoralize a creature as a free action once per round by meeting its gaze, even without speaking.

name: Feather Step
text: You step carefully and quickly. You can Step into difficult terrain.

name: Feelings Brain
text: While you've got just as many emotions as other people, you've got an entire brain dedicated to keeping them under control so they don't interfere with the rest of your brains. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against emotion effects, and if you roll a success on a save against an emotion effect, you get a critical success instead.

name: Feign Death
text: Trigger You take damage. You lie Prone and Impersonate a corpse. As long as you don't take any actions requiring anything other than your mind, you appear dead. To see through your ruse, a creature must succeed at a check against your Deception DC, either by Seeking or Recalling Knowledge. You can Ready an Action without ending this effect if you're a master in Deception.

name: Ferocious Berating
text: You use your encyclopedic knowledge about a foe like a cudgel, energetically castigating and criticizing them with your quick wit and knowledge. You [[/act demoralize]] a target using a skill that could be used to about that target instead of using Intimidation. If you succeed, in addition to the effects of Demoralize, you gain information about the target as though you had succeeded at a check to Recall Knowledge about them with the skill you used in place of Intimidation.

name: Ferocious Recovery
text: When you bounce back from the brink of death, you experience a spike of adrenaline that allows you to ignore grievous injury. Whenever you use Shobhad Ferocity, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level that last for 1 minute.

name: Fight For the Fallen
text: Frequency once per 10 minutes Requirements You're within 30 feet of an ally with the dying condition. You seethe as you see a friend, ally, or companion laid low. This anger hones your vision into a laser-like focus, allowing you to do what needs to be done. Make a Strike, rolling the attack twice and taking the better result.

name: Filtering Tentacles
text: The sensory tentacles covering the lower part of your face are sensitive enough to detect toxins. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against ingested or inhaled poisons. Special You can take this feat only at 1st level, and you can't retrain out of or into this feat.

name: Fire Fighter
text: You have impeccable control over your natural flames and wield them to excellent effect during battle. You gain the critical specialization effects for your burning tendril and solar flare unarmed attacks (whichever you possess). In addition, you gain one of the following benefits of your choice. Broad Flame: Your burning tendril gains the sweep trait. Empowered Flame: Your burning tendril gains the boost 1d8 trait. Explosive Flare: Your solar flare releases a small burst of flame on a hit, dealing 1 fire damage per weapon damage die to all creatures adjacent to the target. Long-Range Flare: Your solar flare's range increment increases by 15 feet. Special You can take this feat twice, selecting from the benefits you haven't yet chosen.

name: First World Magic
text: Your fey heritage grants you innate magic. Choose a cantrip from the primal tradition; you can cast it at will as an innate primal spell.

name: Fish in a Barrel
text: As the old saying goes: hitting easy targets is like shooting fish in a barrel. You Aim and then make a ranged Strike against a Prone or Immobilized creature not benefiting from cover. Treat a success as a critical success. If you roll a critical success, the creature is Off-Guard and Suppressed until the beginning of your next turn.

name: Fish in a Barrel
text: As the old saying goes: hitting easy targets is like shooting fish in a barrel. You and then make a ranged Strike against a or creature not benefiting from cover. Treat a success as a critical success. If you roll a critical success, the creature is and until the beginning of your next turn.

name: Fissile Budding
text: Frequency once per day You can use Change Shape to split two of your identities into two different bodies, each using a unique form and identity. Each copy Strides to an unoccupied square. Both you and your copy act on your turn and use the same pool of actions, the same multiple attack penalty, and the same pool of Hit Points, but if both forms take damage from the same effect, such as from an attack or spell with area damage, you apply the damage only once. In the case of an effect with a save that affects both forms, you take the worse result and apply it to both forms. When this effect ends, you choose one of the two forms as your actual form and the other version of you Strides once toward you before becoming an arm that melds with your body as soon as it occupies the same square as you. If you can't retrieve your arm, you lose the ability to Change Shape into that copy's form and lose the use of that limb until it regrows in 1 week. This effect automatically ends if you are reduced to 0 Hit Points, if you occupy the same square as your copy, or after 1 minute.

name: Fixation
text: You're fascinated with a particular topic, such as the religion of a small sect of worshippers, the process of spaghettification, or the songs sung by asterays. You gain the Additional Lore feat and the Assurance feat for the chosen Lore.

name: Flame Belch
text: Your body has developed a reserve of extra chemicals that can be used to produce smaller expulsions. You gain a flame belch ranged unarmed attack with a range increment of 30 feet that deals ] damage. When you critically succeed at a flame belch Strike, the target takes persistent fire damage equal to half your level (minimum 1). Flame belches don't add critical specialization effects. You take a –2 circumstance penalty on attacks with your flame belch if you can't use your Fire Breath. Special If you have Admixture Breath, you can use it to change the type of damage you deal with Flame Belch.

name: Flamespewer
text: You like to tinker with your weapons so that they can spit fire. During your daily preparations, you can tinker with one tech weapon, using an upgrade slot to apply a chem tank to the weapon until your next daily preparations. The weapon deals fire damage and gains the boost 1d6 and critical (flame) traits. If it already dealt fire damage, it gains the boost 1d8 trait instead. Each time you boost the weapon, it expends 1 chem.

name: Flashing Fit
text: Years of careful attention to your look have given you a deep understanding of the interplay between color, texture, and light, and you know how to make your outfit catch anyone's eye. You gain Vibrant Pattern as a 6th-rank primal innate spell that you can cast once per day. At 17th level, increase the area of your vibrant pattern innate spell to a .

name: Flatten Body
text: You can flatten your body completely to avoid getting hurt. Change Shape and Drop Prone to Take Cover by hunkering down. You can Hide and Sneak due to the greater cover and don't lose the benefits of Take Cover when you Sneak.

name: Fleet
text: Your Speed increases by 5 feet. At 5th, 10th, 15th, and 20th level, your Speed increases by an additional 5 feet.

name: Flexible Augmentations
text: You gain the Augmented Body general feat and can choose an augmentation that costs 500 credits or less. You can swap out the augmentation you chose with this feat during your daily preparations, but the new augmentation must always have the same type (so a biotech augmentation can't replace a cybernetic augmentation). Any augmentation you choose with this feat is considered to be worth at least 500 credits for purposes of calculating the difference between prices when swapping your augmentations.

name: Flexible Breath
text: Your chaotic nature balks at merely a single breath shape. Each time you use your Dragon Breath, you can choose for its shape to be either a 30-foot line or a 15-foot cone. Other than the fact that you can choose between the two shapes freely, the area of your Dragon Breath functions normally and increases with effects such as Deep Breath and Widen Breath.

name: Flexible Grip
text: Frequency once per round Your extra thumb allows you to quickly shift control of weapons that normally require more concentration to manage. You Interact to change your grip on an item you're holding from one-handed to two-handed or vice-versa.

name: Flicker Strike
text: You attack a target with your solar weapon, harnessing the collision's energy to attack another foe at the speed of light. Make a Strike with your solar weapon. On a hit, you teleport up to your Speed into an unoccupied square within reach of a different creature and then immediately make a solar weapon Strike against them. If your initial Strike fails, you don't teleport, and the action ends. Graviton-Attuned Increase the range to double your Speed. Photon-Attuned If a Strike made as part of this action is a critical success, the struck target is Dazzled until the end of its next turn.

name: Flickering Existence
text:
Frequency once per minute
Suddenly, you vanish and reappear in a flash of static. You Step, moving up to 10 feet instead of 5 feet.

name: Flickering Shield
text: You gain the Flickering Shield mod (armor): the wearer gains temporary Hit Points equal to 5 + your Intelligence modifier and regains HP equal to your Int modifier each round the shield is active; it lasts 1 minute or until dismissed, then the item is immune to this mod for 10 minutes.

name: Flight Specialist
text: Whether by natural appendages or through some personal modification, you can fly. You gain a fly Speed equal to your ancestry's Flight Specialist entry.

name: Flight Specialist

name: Flight Specialist
text: Whether by natural appendages or through some personal modification, you can fly. You gain a fly Speed equal to your ancestry's Flight Specialist entry.

name: Flip the Script
text: Frequency once per day Trigger You roll initiative. All the world is a stage and you know the script—you anticipate the direction of the scene and then change it up on your opponents. You can choose to roll twice and take the better result, substituting Performance for the statistic you would normally use for initiative.

name: Floating Balance
text: You are accustomed to floating free in the wide ocean and don't lose your cool when you have nothing within reach. You don't gain the clumsy or Off-Guard conditions when untethered.

name: Floating Flight
text: The membranous webbing between your limbs and torso grows strong enough to function as true wings when you're floating. When you're in low or zero gravity, you gain a Fly speed equal to your Swim speed.

name: Floral Shifter
text: When you change between your flowering and seeding states, you perform other subtle alterations to your body to enhance your abilities. You can change between a flowering state and a seeding state by spending 1 week of downtime. If you're flowering, your pleasant aroma makes you more charming. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks to [[/act make-an-impression options=floral-shifter:flowering traits=olfactory]]; this effect has the olfactory trait. The bonus increases to +2 if you're a master in Diplomacy. If you're seeding, you instead gain immunity to falling damage whenever you're in an atmosphere.

name: Fluent in Critter
text: You're obsessed with animals and communicating with them, consuming countless videos, recordings, and first-person accounts to hone your ability to speak with them. When you attempt a Diplomacy check to [[/act make-an-impression]] on or make a [[/act request]] of an animal, roll twice and take the better result.

name: Fluid Anatomy
text: Frequency once per hour Trigger An enemy scores a critical hit against you with a Strike. Your anatomy adjusts to distribute damage from vital areas. The triggering attack deals only the damage it would deal on a hit (typically normal damage instead of double damage). Any other effects of the attack caused by a critical hit still occur, such as critical specializations effects. Until the beginning of your next turn, you're Off-Guard against the triggering enemy.

name: Fluid Form
text: Your amorphous body flows through gaps. You ignore the penalty for squeezing through tight spaces and can fit through openings one size smaller than usual.

name: Fly Anything
text: You can intuit how even the most interesting vehicles function. You can pilot a ship even if it would be physiologically impossible for you, including those that require telepathy or other supernatural abilities. You can use Piloting instead of Crafting to Repair a part of a vehicle, starship, or mech with a –2 circumstance penalty as long as you have the appropriate parts available to you. You can use Piloting instead of Computers to Hack a vehicle, starship, or mech with a –2 circumstance penalty.

name: Focus Pheromones
text: Frequency once per hour You can purposefully deploy your pheromones to manipulate the reactions of those around you. If your next action is to attempt a Deception check to Create a Diversion, a Diplomacy check to Request, or an Intimidation check to Demoralize, roll that skill check twice and use the better result.

name: Fog of War
text: Requirements You're wielding an area or automatic weapon. The flash and smoke from your frenzied gunfire conceals you from any enemies who might be left standing in the aftermath. You Area Fire or Auto-Fire. You leave behind a cloud of smoke and dust within the area that lasts until the end of your next turn or until dissipated by a strong wind (whichever happens first). Creatures in the area have the Concealed condition, and all other creatures are concealed to them.

text: Your paradoxical nature has become multifaceted. During daily preparations, you can replace one of your paradox spells with a spell of another paradox that grants training in the prerequisite paradox skill.

name: Follow the Bouncing Maraquoi
text: Years of practice leaping from kvash to kvash, kicking off of walls, and racing your peers through the canopy weren't just good fun, they've translated wonderfully into close combat. You gain the Wall Jump skill feat. You can use Wall Jump to make additional jumps off of creatures your size or larger as if they were walls. Once per turn, when you make an additional jump off a creature in this way, you can also attempt to [[/act shove]] or [[/act trip]] that creature as a free action. Special If you have Leaping Expertise, you can jump off a wall to increase your fly Speed by 10 when using a jetpack or jump jet.

name: Follow Their Lead
text: Trigger An adjacent ally Strides. You synchronize your movement to that of your allies, moving alongside them to keep close in the fray. Stride after the triggering ally, remaining adjacent to your ally for the duration of their movement until they stop or you've moved a distance equal to your Speed, whichever occurs first.

name: Follow-Up Fire
text: Frequency once per round Requirements You're wielding two guns, and your last action was a ranged Strike that missed. When at first you don't succeed, shoot again. Make a second ranged Strike using the weapon you're wielding that you didn't fire with. This Strike doesn't count the multiple attack penalty from the prior attack but does count toward future multiple attack penalties.

name: Fonqon Climber
text: As someone who tends to the upper branches of fonqon trees, you spend much more time climbing than most fonqugons and are much better at it. Your climb Speed increases to 20 feet, and you can Climb with your "legs" rather than your hands, so you have free use of your hands while Climbing and can perform tasks such as using tools or firing weapons.

name: Fool the Camera
text: You know how to fool security cameras and tech items that confer special senses, such as scopes. Whenever you use the Avoid Notice, Hide, or Sneak actions, you're always considered to be taking precautions against special senses from tech items. In addition, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Stealth DC to Avoid Notice by cameras and technological hazards.

name: For the Queen!
text: Formian queens are famous for their ability to psychically call upon the various components of their hive to fight, defend, or flee as they desire. You can channel your queen's telepathic power to motivate your own allies into a battle frenzy. Up to 10 willing allies within range of your telepathy become Quickened for 1 minute and can use the extra action only to Stride or Strike. While quickened in this way, they have a +2 status bonus to saving throws against mental effects.

name: Forensic Acumen
text: You glean clues from wounds and remains. You can use Medicine to determine the cause, time, and circumstances of a creature's injuries or death, gaining a +2 to such checks.

name: Forest Shape
text: You call upon the power of the forest within you in order to transform into a tree. You take the form of a tree of the same size and age as yourself. This otherwise has the effects of Tree Shape.

name: Forgiving Anatomy
text: Frequency once per 10 minutes Trigger You would take bludgeoning or sonic damage. You're able to use your internal invertebrate physics to minimize damage to yourself. You gain resistance 10 against the triggering damage and don't gain the clumsy, Deafened, Sickened, or Stunned conditions due to the attack or any ability triggered by the attack. Special If you have Ancestral Resistance (bludgeoning or sonic), you gain resistance 20 against the attack instead.

name: Forgotten Heritage
text: The distant memories of your heritage, once lost and long forgotten, begin to manifest physically. You gain a heritage from your ancestry in addition to this versatile heritage. If an ability from this new heritage conflicts with an ability from your versatile heritage, you choose which of the conflicting abilities your character has, as normal. You count as having that heritage for the purposes of qualifying for feats.

name: Forgotten in the Crowd
text: You can leverage your forgettable appearance to escape your pursuers. You gain as a 2nd-rank arcane innate spell once per day, targeting yourself only. Special If you have the skill feat, you can cast invisibility twice per day instead of once per day.

name: Form Mastery
text: You shift between forms with fluid grace. You can change your assumed form as a single action instead of 2 actions, and your assumed form persists even while unconscious.

name: Formian Biotoxin
text: Your body generates a special biotoxin that you can deliver with your jaws. Your jaws unarmed attack deals an additional ] damage. Additionally, on a critical hit with your jaws Strike, the target must succeed at a Fortitude save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC or be Enfeebled 1 for 1 round (or 1 minute on a critical failure).

name: Formian Scent
text: All formians use pheromones as a supplementary form of communication, and you've become especially adept at detecting scents. You gain imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet. In addition, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks whenever you're trying to locate an undetected creature that's within the range of your scent.

name: Fortified Monument
text: Tapping into the divine magic that keeps the erosion of centuries at bay allows you to harden your body. You can cast Cairn Form twice per day as a 6th-rank divine innate spell that can only target yourself. In addition to the normal effects of cairn form , whenever a creature damages you with an unarmed attack or non-reach melee weapon, the attacking creature takes ] damage.

name: Fortified Shell
text: Your shell is a near-impenetrable refuge. While retracted inside your shell, your AC bonus from retraction increases to +4.

name: Fortune Favors the Bold
text: Requirements Your last action was a Strike that critically hit a Large or larger creature. People think you're just lucky, but in truth, you're simply always prepared to seize an opportunity when it presents itself, even in the face of seemingly impossible odds. Automatically [[/act shove]] the target 10 feet away from you. The target is until the end of your current turn.

name: Foul Fragrance
text: You mix your resin with other chemicals to make yourself repellent to specific attackers. When you select this feat, choose one trait from among animal, beast, celestial, dragon, elemental, fey, fiend, fungus, giant, ooze, plant, spirit, undead, or any ancestry trait, such as human or ysoki. Any creature with that trait that starts its turn within a of you or attacks you with a jaws attack must succeed at a save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC or become Sickened 1 (Sickened 2 on a critical failure). A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune to all foul fragrance auras for 24 hours. You can change which trait you choose by spending 1 day of downtime adjusting your internal chemistry.

name: Four Arm Brains
text: You've dedicated a few extra brains to control more than the typical number of armlike appendages for a fonqugon. You have four "arms," which allows you to wield and hold up to four hands' worth of weapons and equipment. At any time, one pair of "hands" is designated as your active hands. You can change this designation from one pair of hands to another by taking the Switch Hands action. You can wield items only with your active hands.

name: Four-Armed Climber
text: Your additional limbs make you exceptionally adept at vertical movement. You gain a climb Speed of 10 feet. If you Push Off in zero gravity while your inactive hands are not holding anything, you float up to your Speed instead of half your Speed. Special If you have the glacierborn shobhad heritage, the climb Speed granted by this feat is instead equal to half your Speed. If you have the offworld shobhad heritage, you gain a +5-foot status bonus to your Speed when you Push Off in zero gravity.

name: Four-Armed Copaxi
text: You've grown an additional pair of arms beyond the pair that most copaxis have. Your four arms allow you to wield and hold up to four hands' worth of weapons and equipment. At any time, one pair of hands is designated as your active hands. You can change this designation from one pair of hands to another by taking the Switch Hands action. You can wield items only with your active hands.

name: Four-Fisted
text: You have mastered fighting with all four arms. You don't take a penalty to attack rolls when making a Strike with a weapon held in a non-primary hand.

name: Fractal-Lite
text: Frequency once per day. Like the seeds of a dandelion or the intricate connections that allow raxilite Gowan starships to break apart into many smaller independent vessels, you've engineered your body and equipment to be able to break apart into smaller pieces. In this state, you're amorphous. You lose any item bonus to AC and all other effects and bonuses from armor, and you use your proficiency rank in unarmored defense. You gain resistance 8 to physical damage and are immune to precision damage. You can't cast spells, activate items, or use actions that have the attack or manipulate trait. You gain a fly Speed of 10 feet if you didn't already have a fly Speed, and you can slip through tiny cracks. You can reassemble your body and your gear as a single action. If you haven't reassembled yourself after 5 minutes, safety protocols automatically activate to rebuild you.

name: Franchise Manager Dedication
text: You become trained in Society and gain the Management Material skill feat. You can use Make An Impression, Make An Impression, or Make An Impression instead of Society to or Impersonate a professional using Management Material. You can an ally using Deception, Diplomacy, or Intimidation instead of any other skill, depending on what style of management you think will help encourage them. Special: You can take this feat even if you already have the feat and haven't taken two additional AbadarCorp rep archetype feats. Franchise manager archetype feats count as AbadarCorp rep archetype feats, and vice versa, for purposes of completing the archetypes.

name: Frenzy
text: Frequency once per day Requirements An ally you can see was damaged by an enemy since the end of your last turn. With little regard for your own safety, you fly into a frenzy to protect those you care about, gaining a +2 status bonus to melee attack rolls and a –2 status penalty to AC for 1 minute.

name: Frequent Drifter
text: Your connection to the Drift grows even stronger, allowing you to travel through it more often. The frequency of Drift Hop changes to once per hour.

name: Friendly Face
text: You can use Change Shape to transform into a specific individual. As long as you have studied the individual for at least 10 minutes, creatures you do not interact with will not suspect your disguise unless your behavior is markedly different, or the creature has an intimate familiarity with the individual.

name: Frightening Display
text: You disgorge your stomach out of your mouth in a disturbing display of your aberrant heritage. Attempt a single Intimidation check to Demoralize each enemy within 30 feet. Regardless of the results of your check, each creature is then temporarily immune to Frightening Display for 1 minute.

name: Frightful Presence
text:
Frequency once per day

You surround yourself with power that terrifies any who dare approach you. For 1 minute, you gain a frightful presence aura in a 20-foot emanation around you. Enemies who enter the aura (or are in the aura when you activate it) must attempt a Will save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC with the following results. Afterwards, they are temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected by the presence.

Success The creature is Frightened 1.

Failure The creature is Frightened 2.

Critical Failure The creature is Frightened 4.

name: Frilled Vesk Glide
text: You can use your neck frill to glide slowly through the air, 5 feet down and up to 25 feet forward through the air. As long as you spend at least 1 action gliding each round and haven't yet reached the ground, you remain in the air at the end of your turn.

name: From Hope
text: You believe that even in the face of the impossible, from hope spring miracles. Much like Lajok's rekindled light, you always carry this spark of hope in your heart and can focus upon it to make magic. You regain 1 Focus Point, up to your usual maximum.

name: Fruitful Psychic
text: Your psychic abilities continue to expand as your mind starts to meld with the world around you. You gain Entangling Flora and Verdant Code as 2nd-rank primal innate spells. You can cast each of these primal innate spells once per day.

name: Fundamental Understanding
text: Trigger A creature, trap, or similar object within your quantum field casts a spell that you don't have in your spell repertoire, and you're aware of the casting. If the triggering spell is common and you're trained in the associated skill for the spell's tradition, you automatically identify the spell being cast (you still roll to attempt to get a critical success but can't get a worse result than a success). You or a visible ally within 60 feet targeted by this spell gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your saving throw or your AC against it (or a +2 circumstance bonus if you rolled a critical success).

name: Fungal Evolution
text: You can grow into an enormous fungal beast. Once per day, you can cast plant form as a 5th-rank primal innate spell. When you reach 17th level, you can heighten the spell to 6th rank when you cast it. When you cast this spell, you gain the following special abilities: Speed 30 feet Resistances acid 10, poison 10 Melee 1 tendril (reach 20 feet), Damage 2d6 bludgeoning plus Grab. Targets Grabbed by your tendril take ] damage.

name: Fungal Strider
text: Your body's natural secretions cover your tracks. Outside of an urban environment, you're always considered to be Covering Tracks, even if you chose a different activity in exploration mode. You take a –2 circumstance penalty to Cover Tracks in an urban environment due to your messy footsteps.

name: Furious Flap
text: The muscles that control your membranous wings are particularly well developed, and you know how to use them to catch enemies off guard with their power. Once per day while in an area of atmosphere, you can flap your wings to cast Gust of Wind as a primal innate spell. If you're submerged in liquid, you can instead cast Hydraulic Push. After you've cast the spell, you can move up to half your Speed (or half your swim Speed if submerged) as a free action.

name: Galactic Bond
text:
You can bond with a number of additional home worlds equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1), which count against your bond limit. Planetary Bond's edicts, anathemas, and effects now extend to all bonded planets.

At 14th level, add teleport to your primal spell list. You learn the Commune ritual, but can only use Nature to cast this ritual.

At 18th level, treat all bonded planets as within the same solar system as you when casting a spell with the teleport trait. Regardless of your current location, you can cast wrathful storm as a primal innate spell once per day using your spell DC.

name: Galaxy Brain
text: Frequency once per day In an instant, your mind becomes a psychic supercomputer. You become Quickened for 1 minute. You can use your extra action only to Recall Knowledge, make psychic shock Strikes, activate your psychic shock's boost trait, Seek, Sense Motive, or activate abilities with the contemplative trait.

name: Galloping Grip
text: You've perfected the skill of moving around on four limbs while holding on to objects or weapons in your middle hands. While in quadrupedal posture, you can still hold one object or weapon of light Bulk in each of your middle limbs. You can't designate these hands as your active hands until you've returned to bipedal posture with Change Posture.

name: Galvanic Onslaught
text: You can hold on to your natural static charge. Rather than gradually dissipating, it waits to jump to the closest conductor. Your unarmed Strikes deal an additional ] damage on a hit. On a critical hit, the jolt jumps to up to two other creatures of your choice within 10 feet of the target, dealing an equal amount of electricity damage. At 15th level, this damage ignores the target's electricity resistance (and the other creatures' electricity resistance on a critical hit).

name: Gear Authentication
text: During daily preparations you can lock an item compatible with your programming language so only you can use it; others can carry it but it won't function unless they Hack it (DC 10 + your Computers modifier). You gain the Access Remote Gear action.

name: Gelid Bite
text: Your linnorm heritage has begun to manifest more as you've become more powerful. Your jaws Strike deals an additional 1d6[cold] damage. On a critical hit, the target is also Suppressed until the end of your next turn, unless it succeeds at a fortitude|against:class-spell save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

name: General Training
text: Your adaptability expresses itself as a knack for learning new skills. You gain a general feat of your choice, for which you meet all prerequisites.

name: Generic Dictionary
text: Your extensive database of knowledge and experiences enables you to readily break codes and crack passwords. You become trained in Computers and can use Computers to Decipher Writing. You gain the Digital Ambassador skill feat and can successfully communicate using the feat with a flat (DC 8 if you're legendary in Society or Computers).

name: Genetic Environmental Adaptation
text: Your molecular structure is more resistant to certain damage types. You gain additional resistance to the damage type chosen with Molecular Modification. Your resistance to the chosen damage type equals your level, instead of half your level. Special If you've taken Molecular Modification multiple times, you can take this feat multiple times, each time gaining additional resistance to a different damage type chosen with Molecular Modification.

name: Genetic Guise
text: You've lived among other creatures and cultures for most of your life, and you can alter your body and demeanor to precisely mimic a humanoid. You can cast Humanoid Form as a 5th-rank occult innate spell once per day, except the duration is increased to 1 hour.

name: Genetic Pioneer Self-Perfection
text: Frequency once per day You know that changing your body is cheap, but gear is expensive. When you Invest an Item that has the apex trait, you can change the attribute your apex item increases to another attribute of your choice.

name: Gentle Boost
text: Humans familiar with low-gravity environments are also better trained at dealing with the complete loss of gravity. At the end of each round in which you're , attempt a . On a success, you ignore the and conditions imposed by being in zero gravity for 1 round and can increase or decrease the number of squares you move by up to 10 feet (up to 20 feet on a critical success).

name: Get 'Em!
text: As a single action, choose one enemy you can see. Until the start of your next turn, allies who can see that enemy gain a +1 circumstance bonus to their next attack roll against it.

name: Get in There!
text: You urge your allies to hustle into the fight or to get out of the way. Until the beginning of your next turn, you and your allies within 100 feet who can sense you gain a +5-foot status bonus to Speed. As your envoy level increases, increase the bonus by an additional 5 feet at 7th level, 12th level, and 17th level. Effect: Get in There! Lead by Example If you used two actions, Step or Stride. Each of your allies within 100 feet who can sense you can immediately Step or Stride up to half their Speed (rounded down to the nearest 5 feet) as a reaction.

name: Get Them!
text: When you use Get 'Em!, you can choose any number of enemies within range instead of a single target (you still only Strike one target if you spent 2 actions).

name: Get Them!
text: When you use , you can choose any number of enemies within range instead of a single target (you still only Strike one target if you spent 2 actions).

name: Ghost Courier Dedication
text: You've grown accustomed to the unpredictable and ever-changing nature of the Ghost Levels. You become trained in Survival or become an expert in it if you were already trained. You gain the skill feat. Additionally, you've learned how to create and interpret coded symbols used for communication on the Ghost Levels. You learn the Courier Marks language, a language that's only expressed in written symbols. You can always Decipher Writing using Occultism.

name: Ghost Stride
text: You become just barely ethereal as you move, allowing you to move through your foes' space with ease. You Stride twice. During this movement you can move through a foe's space without needing to Tumble Through.

name: Ghostbane Breath
text: Your shadowy blast is formed of versatile darkness or Purgatory's energies, which eat away at the living with negative energy but transform into another form when faced against the undead. If you're a crypt dragon, your Dragon Breath deals positive damage to undead instead of negative damage, and if you're an umbral dragon, your Dragon Breath deals force damage to undead instead of negative damage. Either way, all other abilities dependent on your heritage's associated damage type also deal the substituted damage type against undead. Undead take one additional damage die of damage from your Dragon Breath.

name: Gift of Gadrathar
text: Frequency once per hour You can manipulate the effects of gravity on your own body enough to allow you to fly. You gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed for 10 minutes.

name: Gifted Mentor
text: You have a knack for mentoring others. Whenever you successfully Aid an ally, you increase the circumstance bonus that you would grant them by +1, or by +2 on a critical success. Whenever an ally Follows the Expert, and the expert they choose to follow is you, the circumstance bonus they gain to their skill check based on your proficiency is increased by +1.

name: Gigafuroid Form
text: You trigger a dormant survival instinct to temporarily turn into your species' ultimate evolution. You can cast as a 5th-rank primal innate spell once per day, except instead of choosing an animal, your battle form is an aberration with a Speed of 30 feet and climb Speed of 30 feet, resistance 10 to acid and poison damage, darkvision, precise scent 60 feet, and an unarmed tentacle Strike (reach 15 feet) that deals 2d10 bludgeoning damage plus Damage 2d6 acid damage. You can spend an action after you hit a creature with your tentacle to Grab the target. You also gain the ability while in this battle form.

name: Glad-Hand
text: First impressions are your strong suit. When you meet someone in a casual or social situation, you can immediately attempt a Diplomacy check to Make an Impression on that creature rather than needing to converse for 1 minute. If you fail, you can engage in 1 minute of conversation and attempt a new check at the end of that time rather than accepting the failure or critical failure result.

name: Glide
text: You extend your powerful membranes and flap your powerful arms in carefully controlled patterns, creating enough lift to carry you through the air. You gain a fly Speed of 20 feet.

name: Gliding Wings
text: The winglike membranes that stretch between your arms and torso let you maneuver while floating without a solid point to push off from. While in low gravity or zero gravity, you can take the Push Off action without having a solid surface within reach. In addition, when falling in such an environment, you can move 5 feet horizontally in the direction of your choice for every 20 vertical feet you fall. Subtract this distance moved horizontally from the distance you fell when calculating fall damage.

name: Glimpse of the Bloom
text: Through years of practice, you've honed your ability to see through tricks and illusions of the First World. Once per day, you can cast Truesight as a primal innate spell; use the higher of your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, minus 10 for any associated counteract checks.

name: Glimpse the Pattern
text: You see now; you understand. Your powers come with a price, and your fate is not your own. You're a part of something greater—a pawn in motion within a vast and complex pattern, executing commands long planned and twice foreseen. You're beholden to a higher power, and it has plans for you. If your innate spells are divine, you can cast Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.sX2o0HH4RjJDAZ8C once per day as a 7th-rank divine innate spell. If your innate spells are occult, you can cast Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8kJbiBEjMWG4VUjs once per day as a 7th-rank occult innate spell.

name: Glitch Pulse
text: You gain the Glitch Pulse mod (exocortex or weapon): on a hit, a random tech item the target holds gains glitching 3 for 1 round; a creature with the tech trait attempts a Fortitude save vs your class DC (crit success: immune 24h; failure: glitching 3 for 1 round; crit failure: 1 minute).

name: Glitch Shot
text: You can manipulate and disrupt technology at a greater range. You can use Glitching Memory at a range of 60 feet.

name: Glitching Memory
text:
Frequency once per turn
You've learned how to harness the mechanics of the Gap to disrupt technology. You touch an adjacent object or creature with the tech trait. If the target is an unwilling creature or is held by an unwilling creature, the creature attempts a save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. On a failure, the target becomes Glitching 1. On a critical failure, the target becomes Glitching 2.

name: Glitter Cloud
text: Frequency once per hour You've learned to take advantage of your glitter to help you disappear, rather than stand out. You vigorously shake out your fur, creating a cloud of glitter around you that moves with you and hides your exact location, granting you concealment until the end of your next turn. You can then [[/act step]] or [[/act stride]].

name: Glitter Everywhere
text: You've learned how to further use your beloved glitter to your advantage, shaking it off at the right moment to helpfully share it with enemies. When you successfully [[/act feint]] a creature, it becomes Dazzled until the end of your turn. If you critically succeed, the creature is dazzled until the start of your next turn. The creature can use an Interact action to remove the dazzled condition.

name: Glow Painter
text: Nearly all talphis decorate themselves with swirling, glowing patterns to identify themselves in the dark, and because it looks nice, but you take it to another level by truly immersing yourself in the luminescent art form. You cover yourself and your armor with enough glowing patterns to emit dim light within 15 feet of you. While you emit light, you also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Performance checks to [[/act perform]]. You can cover or uncover the light with an Interact action.

name: Gnarefuroid Lore
text: You are closely connected to ancient gnarefuroid colonies and know how your species survived eons in a hostile universe. You become trained in Crafting and Survival. If you would automatically become trained in one of those skills (from your background or class, for example), you instead become trained in a skill of your choice. You also gain the general feat for Gnarefuroid Lore.

name: Go for the Eyes!
text: Like a squox fighting off a larger predator, you know it's best to dash into dangerous encounters, focus on a single enemy, and go right for their eyes (or other optical receptors). You Stride, then [[/act feint skill=acrobatics]], then make a melee Strike against the target of your Feint. You can use Acrobatics instead of Deception for this Feint, if desired, and the target takes a –2 circumstance penalty to their Perception DCs against your Feint if they're larger than you.

name: Go to Ground!
text: You succinctly direct your allies to find cover by any means necessary. You and all allies within 60 feet count any form of lesser cover as standard cover until the start of your next turn. Lead by Example If you used two actions, Take Cover. Any allies within 60 feet can Take Cover as a reaction.

name: God Mode
text: [one-action] (once every 10 minutes) You can use up to three technomancer spellshape feats as free actions and apply all of them to the next spell you cast this turn. You can apply a fourth spellshape via Jailbreak Spell, but only apply the jailbreak benefit of up to two spellshape feats.

name: Gooey Engulf
text: Frequency once per round You can Stride and move through spaces of any creatures in your path. A creature unable to act automatically critically fails this save. If a creature succeeds at its save, it can choose to either be pushed aside or pushed in front of you at the end of your movement. You can only attempt to Gooey Engulf the same creature once per turn. You can contain as many creatures as can fit in your space. A creature that fails its save is pulled into your body. It is Grabbed and Slowed 1, and it must hold its breath or start suffocating. If you take piercing or slashing damage equaling or exceeding one fourth of your remaining Hit Points from a single attack or spell, the engulfed creature cuts itself free. A creature that gets free by either method can immediately breathe and exits your space. If you fall asleep, are knocked Unconscious, or die, all creatures you've engulfed are automatically released.

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Thievery check to Steal, as your grapple makes it difficult for your foe to keep track of your vestigial arms. You can Steal any immediately accessible item of light Bulk or less on the enemy's person, such as a holstered weapon or a serum hanging from a belt, but not anything inside a container or anything the enemy is holding.
